arguments.sql_query:
WITH ckd_concepts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (443612, 443611)
    UNION SELECT 443612 UNION SELECT 443611
),
ckd_patients AS (
    SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN ckd_concepts cc ON co.condition_concept_id = cc.concept_id
    GROUP BY co.person_id
),
outpatient_visits AS (
    SELECT visit_occurrence_id, person_id, visit_start_date, visit_concept_id
    FROM omop.visit_occurrence
    WHERE visit_concept_id IN (9202, 581477, 8756, 5084, 32253, 8940)
),
lab_counts AS (
    SELECT m.measurement_concept_id, COUNT_BIG(*) AS n_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT m.person_id) AS n_patients
    FROM omop.measurement m
    JOIN ckd_patients p ON m.person_id = p.person_id AND m.measurement_date >= p.index_date
    JOIN outpatient_visits v ON m.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id AND m.person_id = v.person_id
    WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IS NOT NULL AND m.measurement_concept_id <> 0
    GROUP BY m.measurement_concept_id
)
SELECT TOP 25
    lc.measurement_concept_id,
    c.concept_name AS lab_name,
    c.vocabulary_id,
    c.concept_code,
    lc.n_orders,
    lc.n_patients
FROM lab_counts lc
JOIN omop.concept c ON lc.measurement_concept_id = c.concept_id
ORDER BY lc.n_orders DESC;

arguments.sql_query:
WITH ckd_concepts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (443612, 443611)
    UNION SELECT 443612 UNION SELECT 443611
),
ckd_patients AS (
    SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN ckd_concepts cc ON co.condition_concept_id = cc.concept_id
    GROUP BY co.person_id
),
outpatient_visits AS (
    SELECT visit_occurrence_id, person_id
    FROM omop.visit_occurrence
    WHERE visit_concept_id IN (9202, 581477, 8756, 5084, 32253)
),
lab_counts AS (
    SELECT m.measurement_concept_id, COUNT_BIG(*) AS n_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT m.person_id) AS n_patients
    FROM omop.measurement m
    JOIN ckd_patients p ON m.person_id = p.person_id AND m.measurement_date >= p.index_date
    JOIN outpatient_visits v ON m.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id AND m.person_id = v.person_id
    JOIN omop.concept c ON m.measurement_concept_id = c.concept_id
    WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IS NOT NULL
      AND m.measurement_concept_id <> 0
      AND c.domain_id = 'Measurement'
      AND c.concept_class_id = 'Lab Test'
    GROUP BY m.measurement_concept_id
)
SELECT TOP 20
    c.concept_name AS lab_name,
    c.vocabulary_id,
    c.concept_code,
    lc.n_orders,
    lc.n_patients
FROM lab_counts lc
JOIN omop.concept c ON lc.measurement_concept_id = c.concept_id
ORDER BY lc.n_orders DESC;
